title: Jimmy Lucky's sextet in Grand Rapids
summary: Before Kelly Martin he spent six to eight months in Grand Rapids with trumpeter Jimmy Lucky's small band with Bernie Peacock.

story.theme_name: First paying gigs: getting started as a young professional
story.community_name: First paid gigs: pay, bands and young beginnings

blocks.x: Having looked back over the tape, I want to get a little more clarity on that period just before you went with Kelly Martin's Band.

Well, I worked with Jimmy Lucky in Grand Rapids, Michigan. He was a trumpet player and a very fine musician. And Bernie Peacock was in the band and a fella named Palmer on drums, from what I could remember, and I worked with him there.
About five pieces. Yeah. Six pieces actually. And then...
About how long were you with him?
Oh, about six or eight months, you know.
Right there in Grand Rapids, or did you tour?
